## Description

Proposed quantum/quantum-inspired approach to candidate alpha-signal generation: Use a diffusion-style generative model to propose or transform candidate market features/signals; each signal would still require independent out-of-sample validation and explicit trading rules. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
